# THE OPT-IN CORPUS: a committed manifest with one opt-in unit, the rows a leg
# that omits that unit must not be handed, and a control beside each. Format:
# testdata/conformance/tables/FORMAT.md. The harness derives it and filters it
# for a leg that names `unit backenddemo` and one that does not; the two
# filtered manifests are pinned beside it (leg-opts-in.txt, leg-omits.txt) by
# test/conformance/harness/optin_corpus_test.go, and the Java driver answers
# both in internal/codegen/javatable/conformance_optin_test.go.

unit scalars     tables/scalars
unit tblvarevo3  test/tables/varevo/VarEvo3.schema
unit blobdemo    tables/blobs
unit cooktorture test/tables/cooktorture/CookTorture.schema
unit backenddemo tables/backend
opt-in backenddemo
# F-244: a second opt-in unit whose key happens to spell the file a required
# cook-write row reads (the derived line's third column). A unit key is any
# token; the coincidence says nothing about the row.
unit testdata/conformance/tables/json/torture_cook_extremes.json tables/backend
opt-in testdata/conformance/tables/json/torture_cook_extremes.json

connection varevo3_conn tblvarevo3  0x25fed5501e5d7aa5 testdata/wire/tables/varevo3_conn.bin
connection backend_conn backenddemo 0x2309093a1139c6cc testdata/wire/tables/backend_conn.bin

# F-096: `score` on a required unit and `score.json` on the opt-in one. The
# json-write case `score.json` is the required row's and is asked;
# `score.json.json` is the opt-in row's and is not.
instance score      scalars     SimState      testdata/conformance/tables/wire/scalars_full.bin
instance score.json backenddemo StorePurchase testdata/conformance/tables/wire/store_full.bin

# Every surface's own key form: an opt-in instance with an ordinary name has
# the cases wire/plain_text, json-read/plain_text and json-write/plain_text.json
# (the json-write case is named after its file). A leg that omits the unit is
# scored absent on all three, never "the driver wrote nothing"; `score` is the
# control on a required unit.
instance plain_text backenddemo StorePurchase testdata/conformance/tables/wire/store_default.bin

# F-097: one name, two surfaces, two units. The required instance's wire and
# text cases are asked; the opt-in write-refusal row is not.
instance shared      scalars     SimState      testdata/conformance/tables/wire/scalars_default.bin
write-refusal shared backenddemo StorePurchase testdata/conformance/tables/wire/store_full.bin quantity int 100 refused

# F-243: a no-text instance on a required unit has a wire case alone, so a
# json-write-refusal of the same name on the opt-in unit owns `wireonly.json`
# and shares no case with it. The wire row is handed and asked either way.
instance wireonly           blobdemo    Catalog       testdata/wire/tables/blob_equal_bytes.bin no-text
json-write-refusal wireonly backenddemo StorePurchase testdata/conformance/tables/wire/store_full.bin narrow:sku

# F-244: the required cook-write row, whose input file is the instance's JSON
# text, testdata/conformance/tables/json/torture_cook_extremes.json.
instance torture_cook_extremes cooktorture TortureCook testdata/conformance/tables/wire/torture_cook_extremes.bin
cook-write torture_cook_extremes testdata/conformance/tables/cook-write/torture_cook_extremes.cook testdata/conformance/tables/cook-write/torture_cook_extremes-be.cook

# F-186: a write-refusal-message row reads the opt-in unit through its
# connection, so a leg that omits the unit is handed neither; the row on a
# required unit's connection is the control.
write-refusal-message mref_range_high_ok backend_conn StorePurchase testdata/conformance/tables/wire/store_full.bin          quantity       int   99       wrote
write-refusal-message mref_unionstr_ok   varevo3_conn EvoMsg        testdata/conformance/tables/wire/varevo3_msg_notice.bin payload.notice bytes 61C3A962 wrote
